meta.title: Start using Legal Masr
meta.subtitle: A first-case walkthrough for the v0.2.4 public beta.
meta.note: Begin with fictional records while evaluating the beta. Keep a separate backup before using important data.

sections.title: Download and install
steps: Choose the Windows 10/11 x64 installer or a Linux x64 package from Downloads. macOS and mobile packages are not included.
Windows: run the installer, or extract the portable ZIP before opening the app. Linux: use the command shown beside your package.
sections.callout: This beta is unsigned. Windows may show a SmartScreen or unknown-publisher warning.

sections.title: Set up and keep your recovery key
steps: Enter your name and choose a password when you first open the app.
Save the recovery key shown during setup somewhere safe, separate from the computer and backup. Do not send it to support.
Choose Arabic or English and the appearance you prefer in Settings.
sections.callout: Support cannot unlock your encrypted data for you. Keep both a backup and a safe way to unlock it.

sections.title: Add a client and a case
steps: Open Clients and choose Add client. Enter the name and relevant contact details, then save.
Open Cases and choose Add case. Enter the internal file number and available court details, and link the client.
Add related powers of attorney and managed copies of documents as needed. Documents open in the appropriate app on your computer.

sections.title: Plan and record your daily work
steps: Add a hearing to the case, then review Today and Agenda for upcoming work.
After the hearing, record its decision and add the next hearing if needed.
Create preparation tasks with due dates and mark them complete as you finish.
Record the fee agreement, payments and expenses, then review the case or client account.
sections.callout: There are no desktop notifications or automatic reminders. Check Today and Agenda regularly. Finance is for tracking fees and expenses, not full accounting.

sections.title: Create a backup before you need one
steps: Open Settings → Backups and create an encrypted backup manually.
Save a separate copy outside the app’s data folder, ideally on a separate device. There is no automatic backup schedule.
To restore, select the backup, authenticate, review the preview and confirm replacement only after checking it. Preserve a separate backup of current data first.
sections.callout: Restore replaces the current app data with the selected backup. Cross-device restore acceptance remains unverified for this beta. The portable ZIP and AppImage keep app data in the normal operating-system data folder.

sections.title: Export and share carefully
bullets: Export a single case or all records as CSV files with managed documents. Exports are unencrypted and may contain confidential information.
An export is not an encrypted backup and cannot be restored through the backup flow.
Archive hides a record without deleting it. Permanent deletion is a separate action: read the scope confirmation before proceeding.

faq.q: Does it need internet or an account?
faq.a: Core office work runs offline without a mandatory account. Visiting the website, downloading packages or contacting support uses an internet connection.

faq.q: Can my team share it across devices?
faq.a: This release is designed for one lawyer on one computer. It has no cloud sync, team permissions or client portal.
Updates are manual. Keep a separate backup and read the release notes before installing a newer release. Automatic updates are not available.
